points.title: 音乐启蒙
points.description: 舒伯特出生于维也纳一个教师家庭，是家中第十四个孩子。他的父亲是一位学校校长，也是他的第一位音乐老师。舒伯特从小就展现出非凡的音乐天赋，7岁开始正规学习小提琴和钢琴，9岁开始接受教堂唱诗班训练。1808年，他成为维也纳宫廷歌手学校的寄宿生，同时在圣斯蒂芬大教堂担任童声高音。这一时期，他创作了第一批作品，包括早期的钢琴曲和歌曲，奠定了他作为作曲家的基础。
points.descriptionEn: Schubert was born in Vienna to a family of schoolteachers, the fourteenth of fourteen children. His father was his first music teacher. From an early age, Schubert showed exceptional musical talent, beginning formal studies in violin and piano at age 7 and joining the choir at the local parish church at age 9. In 1808, he became a boarding student at the Imperial and Royal Seminary for Court Singers, where he also served as a soprano in the choir of St. Stephen's Cathedral. During this period, he composed his earliest works, including piano pieces and songs, laying the foundation for his career as a composer.

points.title: 师从萨利埃里
points.description: 1809年，舒伯特开始跟随当时著名的作曲家安东尼奥·萨利埃里学习作曲，直到1813年。萨利埃里是维也纳音乐界的重要人物，也是莫扎特和贝多芬的老师。在这位大师的指导下，舒伯特系统学习了作曲理论、对位法和和声学。这一时期，他创作了大量作品，包括交响曲、弥撒曲和室内乐作品。1813年，舒伯特离开学校，回到父亲所在的学校担任助理教师，同时继续他的音乐创作。
points.descriptionEn: In 1809, Schubert began studying composition with the renowned composer Antonio Salieri, continuing until 1813. Salieri was a prominent figure in Vienna's musical circles and had been a teacher to Mozart and Beethoven. Under Salieri's guidance, Schubert systematically studied composition theory, counterpoint, and harmony. During this period, he composed numerous works, including symphonies, masses, and chamber music. In 1813, Schubert left the seminary and returned to his father's school to work as an assistant teacher while continuing his musical composition.

points.title: 艺术圈崛起
points.description: 1814年是舒伯特创作的转折点，他创作了艺术歌曲《魔王》，这首作品立即获得了成功。同年，他结识了诗人约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德的作品，并为其多首诗歌谱曲。舒伯特逐渐在维也纳的艺术圈中建立了声誉，聚集了一群志同道合的朋友，包括诗人、画家和音乐家，这个群体后来被称为'舒伯特圈'。这一时期，他创作了大量艺术歌曲、钢琴奏鸣曲和室内乐作品，包括著名的《鳟鱼五重奏》。1817年，他辞去了教师职务，专注于音乐创作，尽管生活依然贫困。
points.descriptionEn: 1814 marked a turning point in Schubert's composition when he created the art song 'Erlkönig,' which was an immediate success. The same year, he became acquainted with the works of poet Johann Wolfgang von Goethe and set several of his poems to music. Schubert gradually established a reputation in Vienna's artistic circles, gathering a group of like-minded friends including poets, painters, and musicians, later known as the 'Schubert Circle.' During this period, he composed numerous art songs, piano sonatas, and chamber works, including the famous 'Trout Quintet.' In 1817, he resigned from his teaching position to focus on musical composition, though his life remained financially difficult.

points.title: 创作巅峰
points.description: 1822年，舒伯特开始创作他最著名的作品之一《未完成交响曲》，尽管这部作品直到他去世多年后才被完整演出。同年，他感染了梅毒，这一疾病最终导致他的早逝。尽管健康问题日益严重，舒伯特的创作却进入了巅峰时期。他创作了《死亡与少女》弦乐四重奏、钢琴奏鸣曲D.958-960系列，以及大量艺术歌曲。1823年，他被任命为维也纳宫廷乐队的副指挥，尽管这个职位没有带来多少收入。这一时期，舒伯特的作品开始获得更广泛的认可，尽管他生前从未有过公开的演出成功。
points.descriptionEn: In 1822, Schubert began composing what would become one of his most famous works, the 'Unfinished Symphony,' though it was not performed in its entirety until many years after his death. The same year, he contracted syphilis, a disease that would ultimately lead to his early death. Despite increasingly severe health problems, Schubert's creativity reached its peak. He composed the 'Death and the Maiden' string quartet, the piano sonatas D.958-960 series, and numerous art songs. In 1823, he was appointed deputy kapellmeister at the Vienna Court Orchestra, though this position brought little financial gain. During this period, Schubert's works began to receive wider recognition, though he never experienced public performance success during his lifetime.

points.title: 最后岁月
points.description: 舒伯特生命的最后几年是他创作最丰富的时期之一。1825-1826年，他创作了著名的《第九交响曲'伟大'》，这是他生前唯一完整演出的交响曲。1827年，贝多芬去世后，舒伯特参加了葬礼，据说他感叹道'那里有艺术的力量，但我们失去了什么啊！'。1828年3月，舒伯特举办了唯一一场个人作品音乐会，获得了一定成功。然而，健康状况持续恶化，同年11月19日，舒伯特因伤寒去世，年仅31岁。他被安葬在维也纳中央公墓，与贝多芬为邻。舒伯特去世后，他的作品逐渐被发掘和认可，对后来的浪漫主义音乐产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: The final years of Schubert's life were among his most productive creatively. In 1825-1826, he composed his famous 'Ninth Symphony, Great,' the only symphony he heard performed in its entirety during his lifetime. In 1827, following Beethoven's death, Schubert attended the funeral and is said to have exclaimed, 'There lies art, but we have lost what!' In March 1828, Schubert held his only personal concert of his works, which achieved some success. However, his health continued to deteriorate, and on November 19, 1828, he died of typhoid fever at the age of 31. He was buried in Vienna's Central Cemetery, next to Beethoven. After his death, Schubert's works were gradually discovered and recognized, exerting a profound influence on later Romantic music.

supporter.zh: 舒伯特被誉为'歌曲之王'，他创作的600多首艺术歌曲开创了德语艺术歌曲的新纪元。他的旋律优美动人，和声丰富多变，情感表达深刻细腻。舒伯特的作品虽然生前未获广泛认可，但他对浪漫主义音乐的发展做出了不可磨灭的贡献。他的音乐充满了诗意和想象力，将诗歌与音乐完美融合，为后世作曲家树立了典范。
supporter.en: Schubert is celebrated as the 'King of Song,' and his more than 600 art songs开创了德语艺术歌曲的新纪元。His melodies are beautiful and moving, with rich harmonies and profound emotional expression. Although his works were not widely recognized during his lifetime, Schubert made an indelible contribution to the development of Romantic music. His music is filled with poetry and imagination, perfectly blending poetry and music, setting an example for later composers.

critic.zh: 批评者指出舒伯特的作品结构有时不够严谨，形式创新有限，尤其是在大型作品如交响曲方面。他的音乐虽然情感丰富，但缺乏贝多芬那样的戏剧性和力量。此外，舒伯特生前未能充分利用他的才华，生活贫困且缺乏职业规划，导致许多作品在他去世后才被发现和演出。他的早逝也使他的创作潜力未能完全发挥。
critic.en: Critics point out that Schubert's works sometimes lack structural rigor and limited formal innovation, particularly in large-scale works like symphonies. While his music is emotionally rich, it lacks the dramatic power and strength of Beethoven's. Additionally, Schubert failed to fully utilize his talent during his lifetime, living in poverty without proper career planning, resulting in many works being discovered and performed only after his death. His early death also prevented his creative potential from being fully realized.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，舒伯特被视为连接古典主义与浪漫主义的重要桥梁。他的音乐既继承了古典主义的传统，又开创了浪漫主义的新风格。在流行文化中，舒伯特的形象常常与'早逝的天才'联系在一起，他的故事成为艺术与悲剧的象征。他的作品，特别是艺术歌曲和钢琴音乐，至今仍是音乐会和录音室的热门曲目，对后世音乐产生了深远影响。
objective.en: In historical scholarship, Schubert is regarded as an important bridge between Classical and Romantic music. His music both inherited Classical traditions and pioneered new Romantic styles. In popular culture, Schubert is often associated with the image of the 'dying young genius,' and his story has become a symbol of art and tragedy. His works, particularly art songs and piano music, remain popular in concerts and recordings, exerting a profound influence on later music.

self.zh: 我每天都创作，就像别人每天吃饭一样。
self.en: I compose every day, as others eat every day.

others.zh: 舒伯特的音乐是上帝赐予的礼物，他的旋律直接来自天堂。
others.en: Schubert's music is a gift from God, his melodies come directly from heaven.
